subject: number of concurrent users on shinyapps.io

messages.author: fdff4c64ebcda808
messages.subject: number of concurrent users on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I've created a Shiny App that attempt to show my students how the two types of variance of ANOVA drive the changes in the F ratio: (http://utsds.shinyapps.io/ANOVAVariance). When I let my students go "play" with the App, it seemed like a lot of them were getting greyed out screens. It's completely plausible that I pushed out a badly coded App - but it works for me right now as I type this, and for a colleague of mine.

I was wondering if my students were seeing this happen because of the number of concurrent users hitting the page. Is this possible?

How many visitors can a shinyapps.io page handle at one time?

Thanks,
Michael

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] number of concurrent users on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi Michael,
This is not your fault.  We have uncovered a "race condition" in our service that became much easier to reproduce once all the work around speed ups landed.  We are working on the issue and hope to have a resolution for it in the coming few hours.
Apologies for the hassle.  This was quite the unintended side effect of speeding up the service.
-Tareef
